## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the portable gray speckled tabletrashbin and pour into big bin

Task description: Pick up the gray speckled tabletop trash can at the front right of the current view and dump its five red balls of trash into the gray square-opening large bin on the left.

Success criteria: All five red trash balls leave the small bin and land low near the bottom of the large bin on the left. At the end of pouring, the small bin remains held high, clearly above the table rather than barely off it.

## Execution tips

- Choose an intact rim-wall section away from the planned pouring side with approach space inside and outside. Grip the wall below the opening with one finger inside and one outside, preserving pouring space.
- Open only enough to clear the bin rim and confirm both pads surround the same wall section before closing rather than merely pressing the smooth upper edge. A small test lift can check slipping.
- Keep the bin opening facing up during transport and leave clearance between the bin bottom and fingers and the table edge and bottles or bowls behind it, avoiding spills or brushing objects.
- When pouring, move the pouring-side rim of the bucket past the inner edge of the large bucket’s opening, leaving room to rotate between the two rims. Increase the tilt slowly to avoid the balls landing on a rim or between the buckets.
- If trash balls remain in the small bin, keep its opening facing inside the large bin and pause briefly or shake gently, avoiding a quick swing that could eject the light balls.
